title: Relative importance of the anti-apoptotic versus apoptosis-unrelated functions of MCL-1 in vivo | Science
content: The anti-apoptotic protein MCL-1 (myeloid cell leukemia-1) is essential for embryogenesis and the survival of many cell types that tolerate loss of its relatives, BCL-XL and BCL-2. Apoptosis-unrelated roles of MCL-1 in metabolism may contribute to this ...
